acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce first: a test builds an EvidenceReceipt through the real producer in which one attempt ends infrastructure-failed (for example a hook timeout under load) with HookProcess.StdoutSHA256 set and Receipt nil, and records whether VerifyReceipt refuses it. If the producer cannot emit that shape, retain the evidence and close this ticket as not a defect.

If confirmed: VerifyReceipt accepts a well-formed infrastructure-failed attempt whose retained stdout does not decode to a hook receipt, still binding the raw stdout bytes to StdoutSHA256, and still refuses KILLED or SURVIVED attempts without a decoded receipt.
Hostile tests show that a forged nil-Receipt attempt cannot carry a KILLED or SURVIVED verdict, and that a tampered raw-stdout byte still fails verification.
Spec text in the owning BBF spec states the infrastructure-failed attempt rule; focused tests, -race, and sealed change evidence are retained.
body: Suspected defect (not yet reproduced), reported by the V1-1366 lane (PR beamfall/corvint#875) on 2026-10-14 and read by the orchestrator at origin/main 92c298a6e. In internal/behaviorfalsify/receipt.go, VerifyReceipt (func at line 253) skips only attempts whose HookProcess.StdoutSHA256 is empty. Every attempt with retained stdout must have a raw attempt whose HookBytes decode to a HookReceipt with reflect.DeepEqual(a.Receipt, &hook) (line 303), and whose hook.Artifacts must equal a.RetainedArtifacts and declare the native SHA. An attempt that failed for infrastructure reasons but still retained stdout carries a nil Receipt, so DeepEqual(nil, &hook) is false and the whole receipt is refused as invalid. The lane observed that under host load (load average about 60) the live receipts it produced did not verify. Expected: an infrastructure-failed attempt is verifiable as such, with its stdout digest bound, and does not invalidate the receipt. Actual (as reported): the receipt is refused. Unconfirmed: whether the real producer emits stdout-plus-nil-Receipt attempts, and whether that was the actual cause of the observed refusals. Corvint main at 92c298a6e; host go1.27.2; darwin.
title: behaviorfalsify: suspected VerifyReceipt refusal of an infrastructure-failed attempt with retained stdout and nil Receipt
